root_cause.text: The function `dtv5100_i2c_msg()` does not validate the user-controlled `rlen` parameter against the size of the fixed buffer `st->data` before copying data via `memcpy`, allowing an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check (`if (rlen > sizeof(st->data))`) immediately before the vulnerable `memcpy(st->data, rbuf, rlen)` call, which prevents the out-of-bounds access.
